## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m pytest` is green.
- [ ] `python -m compileall -q birthdex` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour (or the change needs no test).
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/*`) when behaviour changed.
- [ ] The captcha remains manual — no OCR, no solving services.
- [ ] No personal data, real registration numbers or captcha answers are
      included in code, tests, fixtures or screenshots.
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, or it is justified below.
- [ ] The diff is focused; no unrelated refactoring.
